lines.beaver: 김 대리님, 회의 준비 상황을 알려 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Mr. Kim, could you update me on the meeting preparations?
lines.beaver_roman: Gim daerinim, hoeui junbi sanghwangeul allyeo jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 네, 안건 세 개를 정리해서 어제 제출했습니다.
lines.en: Yes, I organized three agenda items and submitted them yesterday.
lines.roman: Ne, angeon se gaereul jeongnihaeseo eoje jechulhaetseumnida.

lines.en: Yes, I grouped the materials by author.
No, we chose Manager Park as the presenter.

lines.learner: 열 명 중 두 명이 출장으로 불참합니다.
lines.en: Two of the ten will be absent due to business trips.
lines.roman: Yeol myeong jung du myeongi chuljangeuro bulchamhamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Did you check the meeting room supplies?
lines.en: Yes, I prepared mics and plenty of blank paper.

lines.beaver_en: What is the blank paper for?
lines.en: I prepared it so attendees can freely write their opinions.

lines.beaver: 회의실 문 앞에 붙인 종이는 뭡니까?
lines.beaver_en: What's the paper posted on the meeting room door?
lines.beaver_roman: Hoeuisil mun ape buchin jongineun mwomnikka?
lines.en: It's a no-recording warning notice, for security.

lines.beaver: 회의 말고 소통을 위한 계획도 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Besides the meeting, are there any plans for communication?
lines.beaver_roman: Hoeui malgo sotongeul wihan gyehoekdo itseumnikka?
lines.learner: 소통을 늘리고자 다음 주에 간담회를 엽니다.
lines.en: To improve communication, we'll hold an informal meeting next week.
lines.roman: Sotongeul neulligoja daeum jue gandamhoereul yeomnida.

lines.beaver_en: Good. What will you organize after the meeting?
lines.en: I'll organize the decisions into the meeting minutes.

lines.beaver_en: Your preparation is perfect. Great work.
lines.en: Thank you. See you at the meeting tomorrow.
